note: The population the daily snapshot probes. Pinned on purpose: if the target list moved every run, a day-over-day comparison would silently be measuring a different set of hosts rather than a change in their behaviour. Adding or removing targets is a visible commit, never a side effect.
source: CDP Bazaar discovery listings, deduplicated to one probe URL per host
source_caveat: Offset pagination over a live registry is a snapshot, not an enumeration. Rows shift between requests; hosts present in one run can be absent from the next. Quote this timestamp alongside any figure derived from this run.
